fnol_text: My name is Chloe Raman and I live at 957 Maple Court, Clinton, NC 28391. You can reach me on (555) 591-1130 or chloe.raman@example.com. On 7 April 2024 flash flooding came down the street while my car was parked at home. Water got into the cabin and the engine won't start. Policy MT-2024-00020. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs Raman on (555) 591-1130 to acknowledge the claim. Chloe confirmed the loss date as 7 April 2024.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Mateo Varga gave a statement by phone.
Chloe sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
